note: Human approvals of the Wave 4 §15.3 golden captures. An entry {"file", "sha256"} approves one capture file at one SHA-256, written "sha256:<hex>" exactly as the visual suite writes it into captures.json and qualify:wave4 into the manifest; qualify:wave4 reports any other capture as pending or changed. Approving a capture is a reviewed change by a person, never by an agent or CI.
